key_insight: SciMARS combines shared evidence memory with recursive adaptation of agent roles and coordination to improve closed-loop scientific discovery.
engineering_relevance: Adaptive multi-agent workflows may reduce repeated work and recurring procedural errors as experimental evidence accumulates.
method: Store evolving observations in a shared evidence graph.
Use separate editors to adapt roles and coordination; SciMARS + Memory also adapts evidence recording, retrieval, and delivery.
Probe candidate changes to guide composition and selection of the next agent harness.
evidence_signal: Using experimental-data replay and a digital twin, SciMARS + Memory resolved 12/18 GPT-6-Astra and 2/18 GLM-5.3 Autonomous Science Bench attempts versus 8/18 and 1/18 for the base team, and solved 14/38 ScienceAgentBench and 11/20 AppWorld tasks versus 11/38 and 5/20.
watch_item: The reported evaluations do not establish reliability in live laboratory deployments, and gains vary across models.
paper_title: SciMARS: Multi-Agent Recursive Self-Improvement for Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery
